subject: read.cross warning/error The genetic maps should all be matrices with two rows

messages.author: 7528c3564db27151
messages.subject: read.cross warning/error The genetic maps should all be matrices with two rows
parts:
Hi,
I have the attached input file for R/QTL I am reading this using the following:

threatment=read.cross("csvr",".","Threatment_12x52-order_wp_lodlimit-20_js_sexAveraged.txt.rqtlCrossFormat.csvr",skip=1,genotypes=NULL,crosstype="4way")

And I get the following warning:

Warning message:
In summary.cross(cross) :
  The genetic maps should all be matrices with two rows.

Then if I do:

threatment<-calc.genoprob(threatment,step=1)

I get the error:

Error in map[1, ] : incorrect number of dimensions

I checked the format of my file with the example file http://www.rqtl.org/sampledata/listeria_rot.csv and the format of my file seems to be correct.

I will appreciate if you can help me with this error

Thanks
Hamdi

messages.subject: Re: read.cross warning/error The genetic maps should all be matrices with two rows
parts:
Hi,
I just saw the same discussion on github

https://github.com/kbroman/qtl/issues/9

here the suggestion is 

"Just give the same row repeated, with marker names as column names.
It's possible to estimate sex-specific maps with 4-way crosses, in which case Female would go in the first row and male in the second."

So I did this hack in my code:
threatment=read.cross("csvr",".","Threatment_12x52-order_wp_lodlimit-20_js_sexAveraged.txt.rqtlCrossFormat.csvr",skip=1,genotypes=NULL,crosstype="4way")

for(i in 1:length(threatment$geno))
{
  a=as.matrix(threatment$geno[[i]]$map)
  threatment$geno[[i]]$map=t(cbind(a,a[,1]))
}
summary(threatment)
threatment<-calc.genoprob(threatment,step=1)

now it works. 

I think this should be handled in the read.cross() function when reading a four way cross. I am using the latest version of R/qtl (R session info is given below)
